video_title: Draymond Green Like You’ve Never Heard Him: Fatherhood, Legacy, Basketball & What Comes Next

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the challenges of coaching your own children
quotes.excerpt: If you can help them get to the level to where they want to be

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Let's say you have a kid. If you can help them get to the level to where they want to be in the same profession that you in, do you think that's cool? They try to jump on him and say, 'Man, Bronny don't deserve to be in the league.'

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: They'll go back in the archives and say what I said to try to ruffle up some feathers.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on being labeled a 'tweener' early in his career
quotes.excerpt: When I came into the NBA, I was labeled a tweener. I didn't have no position.
quotes.quote: When I came into the NBA, I was labeled a tweener. I didn't have no position. I was in between positions. And it's crazy because three, four years later, I'm watching the NBA draft and they're like, 'Man, they're trying to find the next Draymond Green.' And I'm just sitting there watching, like, 'Man, this is crazy.' I went 35th in the draft because nobody wanted a guy that looked like Draymond Green, and now they're trying to find the next one.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the shift in how NBA stars are celebrated
quotes.excerpt: Michael Jordan was celebrated, not ridiculed like LeBron James.
quotes.quote: You remember the day and age where Michael Jordan was celebrated, not ridiculed like LeBron James. The coverage of basketball as a whole was completely different. I grew up in that era, and now, being one of the players, and seeing that that's not a thing at all, nowadays, we want to talk about, I can't remember a single time where someone said, 'Man, Scottie Pippen need to win this game or his legacy is tarnished.'

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the difficulty of transitioning to coaching
quotes.excerpt: It's hard for me to unsee it while I'm playing.
quotes.quote: The problem with coaching for me is, and I don't know that it'll change, but it's hard for me to unsee it while I'm playing. It's the schedule. I've been on a basketball schedule my entire life. My whole life has been arranged around basketball. And I just don't know that when I'm done playing, I still want that.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr's coaching strengths
quotes.excerpt: Steve Kerr excels in relationship building and getting the most out of his guys.
quotes.quote: Steve Kerr excels in relationship building and getting the most out of his guys. Now, part of the reason you can get the most out of your guys is because you do such a great job of building relationship that the boundaries kind of go out the window. You can say anything you want to this guy because you've built the relationship, and I can see it for what it's worth. Steve Kerr has to be one of the best I've ever seen.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Steve Kerr's ability to make in-game adjustments
quotes.excerpt: When you're in the heat of the battle, when it comes to making adjustments, Steve Kerr is one of the best.
quotes.quote: When you're in the heat of the battle, when it comes to making adjustments, Steve Kerr is one of the best I've ever seen. So much so that I struggle today watching college basketball because I think college coaches are never making an adjustment. And I played for this coach who was making an adjustment like that, and I think that's very high level.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball and Draymond Green on the impact of LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I thought it was ridiculous when people tried to make it out as if LeBron James did him a disservice.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
